subject: Your friend's 2AM project needs this
preview_text: You know someone burning out on notes. Here's how to help them without saying a word.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, I got a text from a founder friend at 2AM: 'I just spent 3 hours rewriting meeting notes for tomorrow's pitch. I hate my life.' Sound familiar? You've been there too, but now you have Smart Notes. And I bet there's one person in your life—a co-founder, a study buddy, a teammate—who's still drowning in that chaos.

Here's the thing: the best gift you can give them isn't a coffee or a pep talk. It's the tool that saves them hours every week. You already know the relief of opening a perfect summary instead of digging through messy audio files. They don't. And they need it more than they realize.

Inside the app, there's a Share button that lets you send a note directly to anyone. One tap, and they get a clean summary with action items, no setup required. It's like handing them a lifeline at 2AM—without you having to stay up.

Open Smart Notes right now, find your most recent summary, and share it with that one person. They'll thank you later. P.S. If they sign up, you both get a free week of Premium. Some gifts just keep giving.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes and share a summary
